reference.$description: Raw unitless effect values. Consumers use semantic effect roles rather than these primitives.

material.$description: Unitless material rendering ingredients. These tune the backdrop and do not stand in for semantic foreground vibrancy.

reduced.$description: No backdrop chroma amplification when transparency or contrast preferences request a quieter surface.

standard.$description: Gentle backdrop chroma recovery after blur softens the content beneath a material.

enhanced.$description: Explicitly stronger backdrop chroma for decorative material contexts with verified contrast.

standard.$description: No material-brightness lift beyond the authored SDR tint.

wideGamut.$description: Subtle optical lift for displays that can render P3 color without changing SDR fallback contrast.

highDynamicRange.$description: Reserved headroom lift for HDR-capable displays; renderers keep this modest because HDR activation cannot be inferred from CSS alone.

wideGamut.$description: Wide-gamut highlight contribution for brighter material edges on P3-capable displays.

highDynamicRange.$description: HDR-capability highlight contribution, still constrained so SDR content and controls remain comfortable together.
